name: gmail-multi
description: Search, read, draft and send across several Gmail accounts at once; the managed Gmail connector binds to one. Results are tagged with their mailbox, and attachments can be fetched. Every call names its account (`all` searches every registered one). Every send, reply or forward asks you first and is refused when nobody is present. Configure accounts with /gmail-multi:accounts; app passwords stay in the OS credential store. Use it whenever mail spans more than one Google account.

metadata.versioningPolicy: Explicit releases; minor per behaviour change, patch per fix. Bump before any sync or push — an unbumped change ships nothing and looks like a broken install.
metadata.provides: MCP server gmail-multi (8 gmail_* tools: 5 read/draft + send/reply/forward). Registry: ~/.claude/gmail-multi/accounts.json schema 2 (read-only to consumers; its one writer is scripts/accounts.py). Contracts: adr-004-gmail-connector-extraction.md
